summary: The PR refactors AutocompleteJsonView to support extra fields in the autocomplete response, which is a useful enhancement. The changes are minimal and well-contained.

issues.description: The new files `myapp/__init__.py` and `myapp/apps.py` are unnecessary and should be removed as they do not contribute to the functionality of the autocomplete feature.
The new test file `test_autocomplete.py` lacks proper documentation and comments, making it harder to understand the purpose and logic of the tests.
